name: yaps
description: Give AI tools permissioned access to your private local Yaps Markdown vault.
long_description: Search, read, organise, and—only when you explicitly allow it—write your private local Yaps Markdown vault from MCP-compatible AI tools. Yaps starts read-only, rejects stale overwrites, checkpoints write batches when Vault Versioning is enabled, and keeps every operation on your computer. The free Yaps desktop app is required and includes system-wide on-device dictation.
